   (which I will help you up-date) so I can match you to opportunities.

   1) Key requirements in your next position.

   2) Main areas of expertise/ years experience (n/a if resume attached)

   3) Current and desired compensation

   4) Key reasons you would consider leaving your current employer & your
   level of urgency in making a move:

   5) Companies you want to avoid working for and/or already have your
   resume:

   6) Companies you're interested in:

   7) Main achievements in your career (or we can cover this if we meet;

   corner of Main/Rusk, in the Houston Bar Center Bldg):

   specializing in Accounting (including Tax), Finance and Risk Management.
